$comment: Design DNA record. Omit keys that genuinely don't apply. Full record lives here; only the load-bearing subset goes into PROMPT.md (<=2KB).

meta.name: Human name of the style
meta.slug: kebab-case, becomes the skill folder name
meta.medium_of_origin: website | poster | carousel | deck | email | motion
not_copied: real logos, wordmarks, licensed photos, proprietary fonts that were substituted

soul.one_line: max 160 chars, concrete nouns, no marketing words
soul.lineage: e.g. Swiss editorial / 90s rave flyer / brutalist / Vox explainer

banned: colour behaviours forbidden, e.g. 'no gradients on text', 'accent never as a background'

scale.display_to_body_ratio: the typographic signature, e.g. '8:1, never under 6:1'

space.margin_pct: outer margin as % of canvas width
space.negative_space: where the emptiness is and how big

surface.imagery: photographic | illustrated | 3D | none; lighting, crop, treatment

weird_move.what: the single deliberate break in the system
